purpose: A bolder second series of 10 screenshot-grounded CRM redesign concepts

concepts.name: Электрический Баухаус
concepts.ux: Узкая навигация, цветовые блоки этапов, крупные счётчики.
concepts.direction: Electric Bauhaus art direction for a real busy CRM. Bold ultramarine top application masthead, ivory compact 150px sidebar, matte cream workspace. Stage header bands are primary yellow, ultramarine, vermilion and warm gray; their labels retain high contrast. Large black geometric grotesk page title, bold 40px stage counts integrated into each lane header. Squared white lead cards with precise black hairline dividers, emphatic asymmetric button grouping. Strong primary-color geometry and graphic rhythm, full useful Kanban, no decorative shapes. Composition must feel completely rethought as a confident design-studio product.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one BOLD, art-directed redesign of this user's real 01 Academy CRM sales pipeline, grounded in the attached actual screenshots.
Input roles: Image 1 is the actual sales Kanban and the functional foundation of the output. Image 2 is the actual academy overview, Image 3 the actual calendar, Image 4 the actual client table, Image 5 the actual MODAL lead Sheet; these four are supporting product-context references. Keep the same actual product and workflow. Treat the screenshots as a source of real functionality, fields and labels; the user explicitly wants bolder visual and compositional ideas, so substantial changes to typography, proportions, navigation composition, shapes, spacing and material surfaces are encouraged.
Output ONE full-width, flat straight-on high-resolution desktop application screenshot, wide 16:9. Render the CRM only, removing browser tabs, address and bookmarks. No presentation board, collage, inset screenshots, device hardware, perspective, title caption outside the UI or watermark.
Every variant must display the SAME real sales pipeline: title "Воронка продаж"; funnel selector "Основная воронка"; create action "Новая заявка"; filter action "Фильтры лидов". Kanban stage headings in the same order: "Новый лид", "Ответственный назначен", "Недозвон", "Перезвонить позже", with visible counts 113, 11, 104 for the first three. Make at least four lanes visible where possible and at least three complete lead cards per lane. Preserve actual contact name/phone/source/course/manager fields, overflow menus, multi-select controls, unread indicators and quick actions "Записать на демо" and "Оплата". Card details still open as a modal Sheet, never inline; do not show an open modal or a built-in detail sidebar in this output. Navigation may be re-composed into top Tabs, compact rails or a compact Sidebar as specified for this direction, with all actual destinations retained: "Обзор продаж", "Воронка продаж", "Архив лидов", "Расписание занятий", "Все клиенты", "Входящие", "Журнал звонков". Retain access to the five modules "Продажи", "Преподаватель", "Маркетинг", "Финансы", "Администрирование" and "Задачи". Retain search, theme control, notifications, messages, language and account control. Preserve the actual 01 Academy logo silhouette and wordmark, restyled in the direction's colors if necessary.
Use clearly fictional contact names "Алексей К.", "Мария С.", "Даниил П.", "Елена В." and managers "Менеджер А." / "Менеджер Б.". Use masked phone "+998 •• ••• •• ••". Replace even the current user's visible identity with "Мой аккаунт", initials "АК". Never reproduce actual personal names, phone digits or financial records from the reference screenshots. Source badges can ONLY be "Instagram", "Meta Lead Ads", "Telegram", "01academy.uz"; course badges can ONLY be "AI Kids", "Vibe Coding", "AI Creator". Do not invent source "Chat AI" or English-language courses. Product UI is Russian except these existing brands.
Create an ambitious coherent design system with unmistakable composition and strong hierarchy, functional legibility and generous enough touch/click controls. Bold visual decisions must serve navigation and rapid scanning of many leads. Dense card content must be clear, not tiny. Avoid arbitrary new KPI cards, charts, extra business features, AI assistants, illustrative decoration, service explanations, developer hints or technical prose. Preserve modal interaction patterns and destructive confirmations in the design.

VISUAL AND COMPOSITION DIRECTION 11 — Электрический Баухаус:
Electric Bauhaus art direction for a real busy CRM. Bold ultramarine top application masthead, ivory compact 150px sidebar, matte cream workspace. Stage header bands are primary yellow, ultramarine, vermilion and warm gray; their labels retain high contrast. Large black geometric grotesk page title, bold 40px stage counts integrated into each lane header. Squared white lead cards with precise black hairline dividers, emphatic asymmetric button grouping. Strong primary-color geometry and graphic rhythm, full useful Kanban, no decorative shapes. Composition must feel completely rethought as a confident design-studio product.
Deliver one complete convincingly usable art-directed sales pipeline screenshot.

concepts.name: Гоночный пульт
concepts.ux: Компактная панель модулей, навигация продаж в Tabs, плотные карточки.
concepts.direction: Professional racing paddock timing-console aesthetic translated into a usable CRM. Near-black graphite working canvas, vivid signal orange primary, neutral high-contrast offwhite labels, tabular monospaced counts. A very narrow labeled module rail with the five modules and tasks, while the seven sales destinations are horizontal section Tabs across the top. Compact double-level toolbar, sharp densely organized lanes with bold orange stage count blocks and fine white technical grid rules. Lead cards have strong name typography, one compact source/manager line, masked phone and aligned two-action footer. Restrained industrial precision, generous board width, orange/charcoal contrast. No fake gauges, speedometers, pseudo-code or sci-fi HUD.

concepts.name: Кобальтовая суперграфика
concepts.ux: Крупная типографика, плоские карточки, минимум визуальных рамок.
concepts.direction: Bold contemporary editorial supergraphics. Saturated cobalt-blue sidebar with white wordmark and compact white navigation; a stark white workspace with a very large condensed black grotesk title 'Воронка продаж' (about 64px), treated as product typography rather than decoration. Stage counts 113, 11, 104 are big cobalt outline numerals in tall white lane headers, with stage labels below, sharp thin vertical rules instead of rounded lane boxes. Flat white lead tiles separated by precise horizontal rules, strong 22px contact names, small elegant source badges, square cobalt primary CTA. Confident magazine/grid-design composition with striking hierarchy and unmistakably cobalt-and-white identity. Fit at least three complete lead cards per lane despite the typographic ambition.

concepts.name: Титановый Orbit
concepts.ux: Верхняя панель модулей, компактный контекстный список разделов, объёмные кнопки.
concepts.direction: Audacious but legible tactile titanium-and-violet workspace. A polished silver-gray floating top application toolbar, gently beveled real controls, amethyst violet primary action, a light graphite canvas. Five business-module Tabs live in the top toolbar; a slender local sales-navigation strip remains on the left. Kanban lanes have brushed-silver header surfaces with large dark stage numbers and small violet state accents. Opaque warm-white cards, gently raised edges, subtle dimensional button surfaces with clear text, chunky modern sans contact names. One violet luminous edge on the active control, no general glow. Strong fresh spatial composition and material identity, no decorative 3D objects, no actual browser chrome, no translucency under text.
